quests.title: Mineral Research: Icy Pebbles

dialogue.sit: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...
(There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogue.t: During my years at sea, I once heard a call coming from nowhere. The others didn't react at all, but I was captivated almost instantly.
It must have been a voice from another world. I've heard it too.
Only later did I realize... That call carried with it every dream that never made it to the far shore. You might even call it a gathering of regrets.
You should bring an Icy Pebble with you. Look through the hole at its center, and you'll see who's been calling out to you.
But back then, I was still a hot-headed young fool. Even danger looked like an opportunity to me. So I charged straight in without a second thought.
They say the hole at the center of the Icy Pebble is a gateway to another world... But how exactly are you supposed to cross through it?
And after that... the sea and its raging winds took everything from me — my wealth, my honor, and even my family.
Adventures driven by ambition and desire never end well.
Ah, it's stuck...
Let me help you get that off. And next time, try not to do that again, okay?
Linnea! What brings you back here?
I've been collecting Icy Pebbles nearby. I saw you chatting and thought I'd come say hello.
Oh! Maybe you could really use an Icy Pebble to open a gateway to another world, Linnea! If anyone could pull it off, it would be you...
Even I can't do that. Didn't I tell you before? That's just a folk tale people stitched together. There's no solid evidence behind it.
Ugh... Looks like this isn't gonna work.
...Oh. So you were listening.
Ahem... no. I'm not the person I used to be anymore. These days, I'm content with what I have, and I want nothing else.
What a pity. Then I'll help you collect Icy Pebbles too, Linnea.
That'd be great!

dialogue.sit: With Auni's help, the materials were soon collected...

dialogue.t: Thank you, but I've already gathered everything I need.
Alright then. I'll head to Moleyvalley to see Grandpa Moley and the others. See you later!
Hmm, I should head to Moleyvalley to find Grandpa Moley and the others later...
Oh, this calm stretch of sea... It's the final resting place for wanderers like us.

quests.description: A large number of Icy Pebbles are scattered along the western coast of Hiisi Island…
